q: Per the Level 3 manual, which two rooms must be ADJACENT to the operating room?
ref: DOH Manual on Technical Guidelines, 250-Bed Hospital (Level 3), 1st ed. 2017, Vol. 3, 250B-OR-RDS-04A
n: Same pair for the delivery and Caesarian delivery rooms. Remember this: the OR has two best friends: the scrub-up and the sub-sterilizing room. The CSSR hugs both the OR and the delivery suite. Isolation rooms go at the END of the corridor, in view of the nurse.

q: What must the Central Sterilizing and Supply Room (CSSR) receiving area be adjacent to?
o: The operating room complex and the delivery room suite
ref: DOH Manual on Technical Guidelines, 250-Bed Hospital (Level 3), 1st ed. 2017, Vol. 3, 250B-CSSR-RDS-01A
n: Also accessible from the different departments of the hospital.

q: Where is the ICU isolation room placed relative to the ICU?
o: At the end of the ICU patient bays, visible from the ICU nurse station
At the ICU entrance beside the visitor area
ref: DOH Manual on Technical Guidelines, 250-Bed Hospital (Level 3), 1st ed. 2017, Vol. 3, 250B-ICU-RDS-03A
n: Also close to the operating room complex.

q: The Emergency resuscitation bay should be:
o: Close to the emergency suite entrance and adjacent to the nurse station and minor operating room
At the far end of the ER beside the morgue
ref: DOH Manual on Technical Guidelines, 250-Bed Hospital (Level 3), 1st ed. 2017, Vol. 3, 250B-ER-RDS-03A
n: Resuscitation needs speed: right by the door.

q: The Emergency isolation room should be adjacent to which entrance?
ref: DOH Manual on Technical Guidelines, 250-Bed Hospital (Level 3), 1st ed. 2017, Vol. 3, 250B-ER-RDS-06A
n: Also close to the ED exit and accessible to the nursing wards, so infectious patients avoid crowds.

q: The Level III NICU sick room should be close to which rooms?
o: Delivery room, Caesarian delivery room and labor room
ref: DOH Manual on Technical Guidelines, 250-Bed Hospital (Level 3), 1st ed. 2017, Vol. 3, 250B-NICU-RDS-02A
n: And adjacent to the nurse station and work room.

q: The 4-bed ward in the nursing unit should be distant from which department?
ref: DOH Manual on Technical Guidelines, 250-Bed Hospital (Level 3), 1st ed. 2017, Vol. 3, 250B-NU-RDS-06A
n: Close to the nurse station and medical/surgical services; distant from OPD.

q: The nursing ward isolation room is typically located where?
o: At the middle of the ward beside the lobby
At the end portion of the nursing ward, accessible to the nurse station
ref: DOH Manual on Technical Guidelines, 250-Bed Hospital (Level 3), 1st ed. 2017, Vol. 3, 250B-NU-RDS-07A
n: End of the ward limits through-traffic past the isolated patient.

q: The autopsy and tissue processing room should be adjacent to:
o: The morgue and the locker room with T&B
ref: DOH Manual on Technical Guidelines, 250-Bed Hospital (Level 3), 1st ed. 2017, Vol. 3, 250B-MOR-RDS-01A
n: Also close to the ante room/lobby.

q: The MRI magnet room should be accessible from which departments?
ref: DOH Manual on Technical Guidelines, 250-Bed Hospital (Level 3), 1st ed. 2017, Vol. 3, 250B-RAD-RDS-14A
n: Adjacent to the MRI control and system component rooms; near imaging.

q: The post-anesthetic care unit (PACU) should be:
o: Close to the operating room complex
ref: DOH Manual on Technical Guidelines, 250-Bed Hospital (Level 3), 1st ed. 2017, Vol. 3, 250B-OR-RDS-05A
n: Patients move from OR to PACU immediately after surgery.

q: A plan places the scrub-up area across the corridor, 15 m away from the operating room. Which manual requirement does it violate?
o: Scrub-up must be adjacent to the operating room
Scrub-up must be near the main lobby
Scrub-up must be inside the CSSR
There is no requirement for scrub-up location
ref: DOH Manual on Technical Guidelines, 250-Bed Hospital (Level 3), 1st ed. 2017, Vol. 3, 250B-OR-RDS-11A
n: Scrub-up area: adjacent to the operating room.

q: Match the room to its neighbor: Emergency isolation room →
ref: DOH Manual on Technical Guidelines, 250-Bed Hospital (Level 3), 1st ed. 2017, Vol. 3, 250B-ER-RDS-06A
n: Straight in from the ambulance, away from the public. Remember this: the OR has two best friends: the scrub-up and the sub-sterilizing room. The CSSR hugs both the OR and the delivery suite. Isolation rooms go at the END of the corridor, in view of the nurse.

q: True or false: The CSSR should be adjacent to both the OR complex and the delivery room suite.
ref: DOH Manual on Technical Guidelines, 250-Bed Hospital (Level 3), 1st ed. 2017, Vol. 3, 250B-CSSR-RDS-01A

q: Fill in the blank: The ICU isolation room sits at the ___ of the ICU patient bays.
ref: DOH Manual on Technical Guidelines, 250-Bed Hospital (Level 3), 1st ed. 2017, Vol. 3, 250B-ICU-RDS-03A
n: End of the line, in view of the nurse.

q: True or false: The 4-bed ward should be close to the Outpatient Department.
ref: DOH Manual on Technical Guidelines, 250-Bed Hospital (Level 3), 1st ed. 2017, Vol. 3, 250B-NU-RDS-06A
n: It should be distant from OPD.
